newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 24.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp and AB Volvo have agreed to supply cars to each other for sale in Europe and Asia, and to jointly develop a next-generation, fuel-efficient car made by their Dutch joint company for sale under their own brand names.

Mitsubishi Corp and Duke Energy of the United States signed a contract to supply power to an Indonesian electric utility from October 2000. The project will cost about 80 billion yen. Mitsubishi will have about a 40 percent share of the project.
Nippon Polyolefin KK, which handles the resin business for Showa Denko KK and Nippon Petrochemical Co, plans to start making stronger polyethylene resins in 1998.

Oji Paper Co Ltd plans to set up a tree-planting joint venture in South Australia by the end of this year to secure materials for producing paper, in cooperation with Nissho Iwai Corp and Toppan Printing Co Ltd.
They will import wood chips from the venture in 2007 as raw material to make paper. The total investment will be at four to seven billion yen.
